	c.mutex.Lock()
	offset = c.offset
	c.mutex.Unlock()

	switch offset {
	case FirstOffset:
		offset = 0
		whence = SeekStart
	case LastOffset:
		offset = 0
		whence = SeekEnd
	default:
		whence = SeekAbsolute
	}
